key_insight: DiscoveryRSI recursively improves scientific hypothesis generation by learning from evidence-grounded investigations, research contributions, and workflow outcomes.
engineering_relevance: The framework connects multi-agent hypothesis search to executable investigations, offering a design for research automation that learns across successive runs.
method: Evolve hypothesis trees with feasible tests, explicit decision criteria, and alternative explanations.
Compile selected investigations into executable Harbor tasks.
Attribute research credit, replay workflows, and reuse accepted improvements in new investigations.
evidence_signal: Across four life-science domains, automated hypothesis-quality scores rose from 4.86 to 5.39 after two improvement rounds; preliminary human review reported 6.3% correspondence with post-cutoff research versus 2.5% and 2.3% for comparison agents.
watch_item: Preliminary expert assessments and post-cutoff research correspondence do not establish prospective experimental validity or generalization beyond the evaluated domains.
paper_title: DiscoveryRSI: Recursively Learning to Discover Valuable Hypotheses
